name: 小爱音箱
text:
#!name=小爱音箱
#!author=queitstart pro
#!date=2026-11-21
#!format=sgmodule


[Rule]
DOMAIN, mistat.xiaomi.com,REJECT

[URL Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/(info\.mina\.xiaoaisound|marketing-aibox\.v\.mitvos)\.com\/advertise(?!\/banner)/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/(info\.mina\.xiaoaisound|marketing-aibox\.v\.mitvos)\.com\/payGuide\/userCenter/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/(info\.mina\.xiaoaisound|marketing-aibox\.v\.mitvos)\.com\/popup/i then reject_dict(200)

[Map Local]
^https?:\/\/info\.mina\.xiaoaisound\.com\/(advertise|payGuide)\/ data-type=text data='{"code":0,"message":"Success","data":[]}' header='Content-Type:application/json'

[MITM]
hostname = %APPEND% info.mina.xiaoaisound.com, marketing-aibox.v.mitvos.com
